summary_hint: payer/plan, retiree payee, check number/date, net amount and frequency, plus clearing evidence

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: processor — distinguishes check vs stub image

typed_core.name: payer_or_plan_name
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; the retirement income source

typed_core.name: payer_bank_name
typed_core.why: processor — the bank the check is drawn on
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish the payer bank (drawn-on) from the payer/plan (income source) — they are different entities

typed_core.name: payee_or_retiree_name
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; whose income this is (borrower match)

typed_core.name: check_number
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; the check instrument identifier

typed_core.name: check_date
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; check date, drives recency

typed_core.name: benefit_period_start
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the period the payment covers

typed_core.name: benefit_period_end
typed_core.why: disambiguator — end of the covered period

typed_core.name: benefit_type
typed_core.why: identity — CORE; pension/annuity/IRA/other

typed_core.name: plan_claim_or_account_last4
typed_core.why: PII — masked plan/claim/account identifier; must be a named field, not catch-all
typed_core.prompt_hint: Never emit a full account number; mask plan/claim and deposit accounts to last-4

typed_core.name: gross_benefit_amount
typed_core.why: processor — gross benefit before deductions

typed_core.name: net_check_amount
typed_core.why: processor — CORE; the deposited amount (income headline)

typed_core.name: written_amount
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the legal (spelled-out) amount cross-checks the numeric net (OCR/fraud guard)

typed_core.name: payment_frequency
typed_core.why: processor — CORE; monthly/quarterly, needed to annualize income

typed_core.name: memo_or_benefit_reference
typed_core.why: processor — memo line context

typed_core.name: front_image_present
typed_core.why: processor — CORE; whether the check front image is present

typed_core.name: back_image_present
typed_core.why: processor — whether the endorsed back is present

typed_core.name: payee_endorsement
typed_core.why: processor — an endorsement evidences deposit/negotiation

typed_core.name: deposit_account_last4
typed_core.why: PII — masked deposit account; must be a named field, not catch-all

typed_core.name: cleared_or_posted_date
typed_core.why: processor — proof the check was deposited/cleared

typed_core.name: void_stop_orreturn_status
typed_core.why: identity/processor — CORE; void/stop/return status (is the instrument valid)

typed_core.name: related_award_orstatement_reference
typed_core.why: processor — links the check to its award letter/statement

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity — links the document to the loan file

rejected.name: federal_state_or_other_deductions
rejected.reason: object[]; gross + net capture the income figures; no reconciliation rule

rejected.name: property_address
rejected.reason: not relevant to a retirement check

rejected.name: issuer_name / issuer_address / phone / email
rejected.reason: duplicate the payer/plan and bank fields

rejected.name: signature_blocks / notary_block
rejected.reason: superseded by payee_endorsement; a check is not notarized

rejected.name: form_number / form_revision_date / effective / expiration / statement period
rejected.reason: not a standardized form; no consumer

encoding_variations: Numeric vs written (legal) amount: net_check_amount is numeric; written_amount is the spelled-out line — the disambiguator that catches an OCR misread of the numeric
Benefit period may be a single covered month or a range; keep start/end distinct from check_date
Void/stop/return status appears as a stamp, a memo, or an image overlay — capture verbatim

open_questions.q: Check vs deposit evidence — a retirement check may be submitted as proof of income OR as proof of deposit (with clearing evidence). The clearing fields (cleared_or_posted_date, payee_endorsement, deposit_account_last4) only fill in the latter case.
options: keep the clearing fields (cheap, null when absent)

open_questions.q: written_amount value — included as an OCR/fraud disambiguator for the numeric net. If it proves rarely populated on modern printed checks, it can be dropped.

notes: No rules read this document today (rule_count 0); there is no rule floor. A retirement check evidences receipt of retirement income (an income-continuance / deposit source). Fields earn a place by identity, PII protection, disambiguation, or processor use.

plan_claim_or_account_last4 and deposit_account_last4 need _PII_FIELDS registration, pre_masked true (catalog sensitivity restricted; issuer prints last-4). Payee name is standard sensitivity → identity field, not registry PII.
Prompt hint (doc-level): Do NOT judge whether income is stable/continuing — extract amount, frequency, and dates; a rule/tag judges continuance.
